 DAYTON, Ohio (WKEF) -- Firefighters are responding to an apartment fire in Dayton Saturday afternoon.
 They were called out a little before 5 p.m. near Rugby Road and Cherry Drive.
 Dayton 24/7 Now crews are on scene.
 We will provide updates as more information becomes available.
